name: project_hero_stage_website
title: Project Hero Stage: Website
summary: Website stage of the project hero (browser + phone).
description: The website stage of project_hero: the cover desktop screenshot in a browser frame (the project name in its bar) + the cover phone screenshot in a phone frame, both tilting in a slow loop. The screenshots look like the device card screens (theme mixin device-screen + project_desktop_layout_style placement classes). Links to the screens section. Rendered by project_hero; frame colors, the stage base and the tag come from it.
